tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. A cool off-white that keeps large empty areas feeling airy rather than stark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and menus that sit on surface. Pair with shadow-soft or a line border, never both heavy.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised and every tint (16:1 on surface). Also the text colour on orange-500 and gradient-deal (6.6:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, timestamps, helper text, store URLs. 5.6:1 on surface, 5.9:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers between list rows and around inputs. Decorative only; not for control boundaries that must be seen (use ink-muted for those).

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, unselected chips and the off state of switches: anything a person has to find and operate. 3.4:1 on surface-raised, 3.2:1 on surface.

tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: Primary brand blue: links, focus rings, selected states, active tracker toggles. 5.7:1 on surface-raised, 5.0:1 on blue-100.

tokens.name: blue-100
tokens.usage: Blue tint for selected rows, info callouts and the background of tracker chips. Text on it is ink or blue-600.

tokens.name: orange-500
tokens.usage: Deal accent: the colour that means 'an offer is live'. Fills for deal badges, price-drop markers and the notification dot. Never as text; put ink on top of it.

tokens.name: orange-700
tokens.usage: Orange as text: discount amounts and 'ends soon' labels on surface-raised (5.2:1) or orange-100 (4.7:1).

tokens.name: orange-100
tokens.usage: Orange tint behind deal highlights and the 'new offer' row state. Text on it is ink or orange-700.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing hero and empty-state headlines only. One per page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card titles: store names, tracker names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We check this store every 30 minutes and email you when a campaign starts.
styles.usage: Default reading text. The generous line height is part of the spacious feel.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text, table cells. Usually in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase badges and overlines: deal badges, status chips, form labels above inputs.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Between a heading and the line directly under it (a title and its summary, a step title and its text).

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-xs-sm
tokens.usage: Compact rows and controls: padding of dense notification rows, notices and nav links; the gap between a marker and its text.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between related items: stacked form fields, list rows, button groups.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Card padding and the gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Between sections within a page; page side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Between major page bands (hero to content) and on marketing pages. Use it freely: empty space is the look.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, small tiles, store logos.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals, the hero gradient block.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large decorative shapes behind framed content, such as the gradient-horizon glow behind the landing-page demo.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Deal badges, status chips, toggles, the notification dot.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Resting cards on surface. Barely there, so the layout reads through space rather than boxes.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, open menus and modals. The blue cast ties elevation to the brand.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content in the app and on the landing page. Pages add space-lg side padding outside it on narrow screens.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals, so the page recedes without going dark. Never as a fill for content.

tokens.name: gradient-primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and the active tab indicator. White text on it passes 4.6:1 at its lightest end.

tokens.name: gradient-deal
tokens.usage: Deal badges and the 'offer found' highlight. Ink text only, never white.

tokens.name: gradient-horizon
tokens.usage: The signature blue-to-orange sweep: hero blocks, onboarding illustration, the logo tile. At most one per screen, no text on its middle.

tokens.name: gradient-wash
tokens.usage: Very soft background behind a marketing hero or empty state. Any text style may sit on it in ink.
